params.name: sort
params.description: Sorts output by specified value in descending order.

params.name: start-date
params.description:
Start Date of range to get data from as defined by RFC 3339,
section 5.6, for example, 2017-07-21.

params.name: end-date
params.description:
End Date of range to get data from as defined by RFC 3339,
section 5.6, for example, 2017-07-21.
If defined, start-date is required.

items.docs:
Date rules:
  • If you do not specify a start or end date, it will generate a report of the first of the current month to present.
  • If you specify a start date and an end date, they cannot span more than a year.
  • If you specify a start date without an end date, it will fetch either a month from start date, or the current day. Whichever is less.
  • If you specify an end date without a start date, it will error.
